description: Ask a seller to price a bulk order. No sign-in required if you pass buyer_email, which is where the seller replies. buyer_email is always required, including when you are signed in. Anonymous requests are limited to 5 per hour. Sign in with buyer access to attach the quote to your account. Save status_token and pass it to get_quote_status. This does not charge a card. Sensitive: requires user approval each time.

idempotency_key.description: Required. 8–200 characters (letters, digits, . _ : -). The same key returns the original result for 24 hours and is sent to Stripe as Idempotency-Key.

product_id.description: Exact id from search, for example product_2731

target_price.description: Target price per unit in cents (optional)

name: request_quote

expected_response.description: What happens next. The seller is notified. There is no guaranteed reply time.

target_price.description: Buyer target per unit, as supplied.

status_token.description: Pass to get_quote_status to read this quote back. Keep it: an anonymous caller has no other way in.

title: Request a bulk quote
